english: "Brother, wake up! Dawn has become bright." "I am awake, and I tremble. In a dream I saw a snake. It crept toward our household." "Do not be afraid, brother. A dream does not kill." "I trust you, and my heart is trembling." "Stand up, and put on your wool. Let us two go to the stream and drink." "If the snake comes, I shall overpower it." "You have become strong, brother, and you are not afraid." "A snake gives a sign. Let us two go to the hill and look."

english: It was getting dark. Then the guests arrived, and the cook was cooking. Then the king and the queen arrived, and the two sat down. "Who is this man?" "This is the husband's brother." "And who is that one yonder?" "That is the wife's brother." Then the father gave wine to them. Then they ate the lamb, and they drank wine and beer, and they spoke a song. Then the cook was content, and the shepherd spoke a song of praise. Then the king said: "This household is dear to me. May your fame be great." Then the two brothers spoke a song of praise. Then the brother of the bride stood up and said: "Be content!" The night became cold. Then they lay down.

english: "You are the mistress of this household, and I am the man." "Enter." "I enter. I shall carry you in. Do not slip." "I am not afraid. My body is strong, and my heart is content." "Your fire is my fire, and your name is my name." "I have heard your words." "You are dear to me." Then she stood at the door, and the fire shone. Then the husband's mother said: "This is my brother, and this is my mother." "Hail, brother-in-law! Hail, father-in-law!"

english: "Who is Mother Earth?" "The Earth is the mother of mortals. She nourishes them, and Father Sky is their father." "Where is the sky?" "Father Sky is above us, and Mother Earth is under us." "Does the sky hear us?" "He hears and sees." "I shall speak to him." "Speak, and he will hear." "And who is Perkwunos?" "Perkwunos is a god. When he comes, it rains, and the earth is wet." "Is the sun a god?" "The sun brings light and warms the earth."

english: "Swift One, yoke the cattle and bring the plough." "How shall I plough?" "Plough the field, and the field will nourish us. Make the path straight, and pull the plough." "I am working." "Look at the field! Your work is good. Now cut the tree, and split it." "I shall cut it, and then I shall build an enclosure for the sheep." "You are working. Sit down under the tree, and sip water."

english: "The night is coming, and I tremble." "Do not be afraid. The dog guards the enclosure. Lie down, and listen to my song." "What stands?" "The tree stands." "What runs?" "The stream runs." "What burns?" "The fire burns." "What grows?" "The rye grows." "Who dies?" "The mortal dies. The god does not die." "I am listening. Is the snake near?" "The snake is not creeping." "May a good dream come to you. Dawn will become bright, and you will see the sun." "The duck lies flat on the water, the snake lies flat, and the beast is far off."

english: "Hear my words. I remember. I caught sight of your mother at the river. I got to know her: she was my desire, and I loved her. Then I gave a hundred sheep and ten cattle. Then my father-in-law gave her to me. We two live together, and you were born. Your mother is good." "Did mother love you?" "She loved me, and I love her." "I trusted her, and she trusted me." "I built this house."

english: The two swift horses arrived. Then the husband's mother saw the daughter-in-law and became glad. "Daughter-in-law, come inside. May our fire be dear to you." Then the husband's brother brought wine. "Sit down and drink." Then the husband's mother gave the daughter-in-law an ornament. "Take it, and wear it." Then the daughter-in-law said: "I bring wool and silver for you. I am your daughter-in-law, mother. I shall love you." "Welcome, daughter-in-law!" "Hail, husband's brother!"
